name: Synthetic Flat-Region Void Ratio
description: The absolute nightmare of artificial algorithmic perfection. When generative engines like Midjourney attempt to hallucinate human skin or coarse brickwork, their inherent mathematical nature (bias towards catastrophic Denoising logic) inevitably renders surfaces that are impossibly smooth, waxy, and hyper-perfectly void of the chaotic micro-roughness organic reality demands. This perimeter scanner violently sweeps the canvas to calculate the percentage of entirely 'bald' microscopic zones. If the void spans too wide (e.g., flawless skin completely stripped of protruding optical pores), the siren wails.
mechanism: The algorithm unleashes a microscopic mesh sieve over every patch. It relentlessly hunts for dead zones where the luminous variance of pixels plunges into an absolute, sterile mathematical Zero (like the surface of a synthetic CD). Surfaces captured by authentic physical glass always harbor a microscopic chaotic ripple from analog ISO sensor grain—organically barring outright perfection. Any patch meeting extreme synthetic smoothness is aggressively scaled globally. A massive void percentage equates to a 90% conviction of synthetic, inorganic AI genesis.
parameters: Morphology Sweep: Local Micro-Variance Mapping, Saturation Threshold: Deviation Tolerance < 3, Core Metric: Total Coverage Void Scaling
accuracy: Extremely Solid (77-85%) - A brutal guillotine explicitly calibrated to decapitate hyper-flawless 'Plastic Look' AI portraits or airbrushed synthetic counterfeits.
source: AI Generation Plastic Skin Masking & Surface Topography Eradication Archives
useCase: Brings the executioner's sledgehammer violently crashing down upon supposed 8K artistic masterpieces. Though radiantly stunning to human eyes, hyper-zoom reveals a soulless slab of computational wax. This ratio instantly measures and mathematically dictates the forgery.

references.title: Marra, F., et al. (2020). A full-image full-resolution end-to-end-trainable CNN framework for image forgery detection. IEEE Access.

strengths:
• Bypasses the optical illusion of hyper-resolution upscaling. The more aggressively AI upscales an image, the wider and more bloated the bald, smooth void stretches, allowing the algorithm to trigger catastrophically massive alarms.
• Savagely direct when hunting down AI In-painting patches (synthetic gap fillers), as the forged patch inevitably shines with a stubborn, pristine smoothness entirely alien to the neighboring authentic organic grit.
limitations:
• The forensic blade shatters into pieces (incurring severe False Positives) when confronted with an authentically ultra-smooth physical object: e.g., a freshly waxed Lamborghini or a pristine glass skyscraper reflecting a cloudless sky—these organically mimic AI perfection.
• Completely disarmed and neutralized if an elite hacker artificially marinates the deepfake in dense Lightroom Film Grain, injecting a barrage of synthetic rough particles to suffocate the algorithm's baldness sensors.
